summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 10,892,661 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on 27 April 2026. Shares were bought at a volume-weighted average price of 97.8985 pence, with prices ranging from 97.34 to 98.54 pence. The purchases are part of an existing buyback programme announced 30 January 2026, under a mandate effective 29 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding capital. This open-market buyback is a routine capital return; the company intends to cancel all repurchased shares.
